column1: # The pictures `just render` draws: name, syringe, view, flags, tab-separated.
# view   iso, iso_back, front, back, right, left, top, bottom, or a rotation copied from the
#        GUI (Edit > Copy Viewport Rotation), for an angle found by eye.
# flags  -D settings from main.scad's Customizer: part (assembly, housed, or a printed part),
#        motor, angle (the crank's, 0 pulled out, 180 pushed in), show_bought, and section with
#        section_at to cut it open: section removes the + side of the plane.
# `just render-parts` draws every printed part without a row, and `just render-stroke` one turn of
# the crank as a GIF. The rows are the second 5 mL (5ml-gnr2), the syringe the bioreactor's sampler
# drives, each drawn with its own frame and body. Labels and callouts are drawn by hand over these.
# the mechanism, at the default angle (180, pushed in)
# one stroke, from above: the crank at 0, 90, 180 and 270 degrees
# in its body, whole and cut along the syringe's axis; section="y" keeps the -y half, so the
# cut face is seen from behind
# the GA25 motor, which drives 10 mL and up
